mapper.insert: insert into app.utilisateur (cip, pseudo, courriel, nom, prenom, photo_de_profil_id) values (#{cip}, #{pseudo}, #{courriel}, #{nom}, #{prenom}, #{photoProfilId}) on conflict (cip) do update set pseudo = excluded.pseudo, courriel = excluded.courriel, nom = excluded.nom, prenom = excluded.prenom, photo_de_profil_id = excluded.photo_de_profil_id
mapper.select: SELECT cip, pseudo, nom, prenom, courriel, photo_de_profil_id FROM app.utilisateur WHERE ((#{cip, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (cip ILIKE CONCAT(#{cip, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))) AND ((#{pseudo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (pseudo ILIKE CONCAT(#{pseudo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))) AND ((#{courriel, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (courriel ILIKE CONCAT(#{courriel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))) AND ((#{nom, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (nom ILIKE CONCAT(#{nom, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))) AND ((#{prenom, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (prenom ILIKE CONCAT(#{prenom, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')))

SELECT cip, pseudo, nom, prenom, courriel, photo_de_profil_id FROM app.utilisateur WHERE cip = coalesce(#{cip}, cip) AND pseudo = coalesce(#{pseudo}, pseudo) AND courriel = coalesce(#{courriel}, courriel) AND (#{cip} IS NOT NULL OR #{pseudo} IS NOT NULL OR #{courriel} IS NOT NULL)
SELECT u.cip, u.pseudo, u.courriel, u.nom, u.prenom, u.photo_de_profil_id FROM app.Contact c JOIN app.Utilisateur u ON c.cip_contact = u.cip WHERE c.cip = #{cip}
